_comment: USD per 1M tokens, first-party API list prices. Confirmed 2026-10-17 via the claude-api skill's cached rate table (sourced 2026-10-06). Re-verify periodically — prices change between model generations.
_caveats: session_cost.py bills cache-creation and cache-read tokens at the same input_per_mtok rate as regular input. Real cache reads are cheaper (~$0.20/MTok for opus/sonnet), so the script's estimate is conservative (slightly overstates cost), never understates it.

claude-haiku-5-5 output_per_mtok applies to prompts up to 100K tokens; beyond that it rises to $0.50 input / $2.50 output. Subagent calls in this repo's pipeline are short, so the base rate is the right approximation here.
